memories.title: Rainy Concert Night Journal
memories.description: Journal entry Oct 12: What a magical rainy night. Coming out of the concert drenched to the bone, finding that tiny ramen bar tucked behind the station alley...
memories.textContent:
# Oct 12 — Drenched & Euphoric

What a night. The concert ended around 10:45 PM with an insane encore guitar solo. By the time we hit the street, it was torrential rain. No taxis anywhere. We ran through the glowing neon puddles laughing until we spotted the red lantern of that tiny basement ramen shop.

Sitting on wooden stools, shaking off the rain, sipping boiling tonkotsu broth... pure perfection.

memories.title: Shibuya Ramen Shop Review
memories.description: Review: Hidden gem tonkotsu ramen shop in Shibuya. 18-hour rich pork bone broth, springy handmade noodles, perfect garlic oil drizzle. The best bowl on a cold rainy night.
memories.textContent:
# Shibuya Ramen Bar Review

⭐ 5/5 — Hidden alleyway shop.
- Broth: Deep, creamy 18-hour pork bone with black garlic oil.
- Noodles: Firm (katame), thin Hakata style.
- Egg: Ajitsuke tamago with molten golden yolk.
- Best for: Cold rainy nights after events.

memories.title: Pour-Over Brew Guide
memories.description: Morning coffee recipe: 1:16 brew ratio, 18g light roast Ethiopian beans, medium-fine grind, 93°C water. 45-second bloom followed by two concentric circular pours.
memories.textContent:
# V60 Pour-Over Recipe
- Dose: 18g specialty coffee beans (medium-fine)
- Water: 288g filtered water at 93°C (199°F)
- Ratio: 1:16
- Bloom: 50g water, 45 seconds spiral stir
- Pour 1: Up to 180g by 1:30
- Pour 2: Up to 288g by 2:15, drawdown finishes ~3:00.
